about: Written for this test: a stir-fry with a sauce whisked ahead in a bowl and poured in later, and three vegetables that go in together.
name: Honey Garlic Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 pound chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar and cornstarch. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the bell pepper, broccoli and carrot and cook, stirring, until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Pour in the sauce and cook until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Top with the green onions and serve.
